name: ComfyUI Retro Anime Skill
headline: Avatar Video: AI Avatar Video Generation
short_description: The avatar-video skill allows users to generate and incorporate personalized avatar videos into their applications. It is designed for developers looking to enhance user engagement through interactive media.
author: heygen-com

sections.overview:
The avatar-video skill transforms a photo into a reusable digital avatar that delivers scripted video messages. It works by first creating a persistent avatar identity from your photo, then generating videos where that avatar speaks your script with synchronized lip-sync. The skill handles script generation, video rendering, and returns a shareable link—ideal for developers building personalized video experiences, marketing automation, or interactive applications. Authentication supports both API key and OAuth modes, and videos can be generated in 175+ languages with voice cloning.
Generate personalized avatar videos for user profiles
Enhance marketing materials with unique video content
Create interactive tutorials using avatars
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/heygen-com/skills --skill avatar-video`
`git clone https://github.com/heygen-com/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a personalized avatar video for [COMPANY], [INDUSTRY], using the following script: '[SCRIPT_TEXT]'. The avatar should match the tone of [TONE: professional/friendly/energetic]. Use a [STYLE: realistic/cartoon/3D] avatar and export it in [FORMAT: MP4/MPG/WEBM] with dimensions [RESOLUTION: 1080p/720p/480p].
```
Copy
